metadata.description: Generate a renewal quote for a specified contract in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Generate a renewal quote for a specified contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to create a new renewal quote based on the contract identified by the contractId path parameter. The request must include a quoteTemplateId to specify the template for the renewal quote.

contractId.label: Contract Id
contractId.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the renewal quote is being created.

dealId.label: Deal Id
dealId.description: The unique identifier of the deal associated with the renewal quote. It is a string.

dealPipeline.label: Deal Pipeline
dealPipeline.description: The pipeline in which the deal associated with the renewal quote resides. It is a string.

dealStage.label: Deal Stage
dealStage.description: The stage of the deal associated with the renewal quote. It is a string.

name.label: Name
name.description: The name of the renewal quote. It is a string.

quoteTemplateId.label: Quote Template Id
quoteTemplateId.description: The unique identifier of the template used for the renewal quote. This is a required property and is a string.
